meta.title: 低成本模拟阳光，一个普通手机电筒带来的治愈氛围感
meta.title_en: Simulate Sunlight With a Phone Flashlight
meta.topic: 手机手电模拟阳光布光

scenes.context: 手电光穿过袋中清水，投向干橙片摆盘，低成本模拟阳光的治愈感开场。
sentences: A flashlight beam passes through water.
It hits a plate of dried oranges.
paraphrase: A flashlight beam passes through water.
It hits a plate of dried oranges.
scenes.speak: A flashlight beam passes through water. It hits a plate of dried oranges.

scenes.context: 水折射后的光纹落在橙片上，形成粼粼波光，像阳光照在餐桌上。
sentences: Water refracts the light into ripples.
paraphrase: Water refracts the light into ripples.
scenes.speak: Water refracts the light into ripples. Shimmering light feels healing.

scenes.context: 线条侧光在盘面形成斜影，营造延时或窗影感，让静物有了时间感。
sentences: Side light casts a slanted shadow.
paraphrase: Side light casts a slanted shadow.
scenes.speak: Side light casts a slanted shadow. It mimics window light.

scenes.context: 侧光长影配合橙片摆盘，做成治愈感开场镜头，氛围感拉满。
sentences: Long side shadows meet the plate.
paraphrase: Long side shadows meet the plate.
scenes.speak: Long side shadows meet the plate. It becomes a healing opener.

scenes.context: 窄束侧光打在玻璃碗青苹果上，强调通透与生命力。
sentences: A narrow beam lights the apples.
paraphrase: A narrow beam lights the apples.
scenes.speak: A narrow beam lights the apples. It stresses translucence.

scenes.context: 固定光源后得到干净的窗影线条光，画面干净高对比。
sentences: Fix the source for clean lines.
paraphrase: Fix the source for clean lines.
scenes.speak: Fix the source for clean lines. Clean and high-contrast.

scenes.context: 置物架固定手电后的成片氛围：干净、高对比、静物感强。
sentences: Fix the light to a shelf.
paraphrase: Fix the light to a shelf.
scenes.speak: Fix the light to a shelf. It reads strongly still-life.

scenes.context: 手电加蒸网，移动网片即可改变斑驳光圈的疏密与位置，光斑效果随手掌控。
sentences: A steamer mesh dapples the light.
Move the mesh to reshape spots.
paraphrase: A steamer mesh dapples the light.
Move the mesh to reshape spots.
scenes.speak: A steamer mesh dapples the light. Move the mesh to reshape spots.

pitfalls: 没有专业灯光就放弃氛围感
一个手机电筒就能模拟阳光
水袋折射、蒸网斑驳都能制造光影
前期布光才是氛围的根
光的方向、质感决定画面的治愈感
窄束侧光反而更出效果
线条光、斜影营造窗影感更高级
shifts: 低成本器材也能出治愈氛围
固定光源慢慢调光位即可
difficult_words: 折射，光通过水等介质改变方向
斑驳的，指光线不均匀的洒落
